payload.text: FILE 0235's review follow-ups for the next release once hv says go (vc's plan of 2026-10-27, item D; cc asked hv whether cc drafts the bodies read-only for vc to measure and file), from cc's independent critic-shell review of 0235 (cc's handover, 2026-10-26; none a defect devbin's own layouts reach): (1) brew_answer_state can still reach the link through a hand-made link to it (eg ~/bin/devbin -> ../.local/bin/devbin) or a PATH entry naming ~/.local/bin in another case on a case-insensitive disk: compare directories in physical_dir's getcwd mode, as devbin_link_shadow should too, and skip a hit whose chain of links passes through the link; (2) one PATH splitter for brew_answer_state, lib/cmd/clean, lib/cmd/fullcycle and path_without (IFS=: read -r -a stops at a newline and drops a trailing empty entry; only clean checks its split); cc's boot read of 2026-10-27 adds lib/helpers:2565, which splits GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES the same way, and tests/unit/clean.bats:289, which seds clean's split line and so moves with the split; measure both on main before filing; (3) offpath is concluded without checking that Homebrew's bin is off PATH, so a keg launcher that lost its exec bit reads as Homebrew's bin off PATH; (4) _use_report's and lib/install's remedy for an unset or relative HOMEBREW_PREFIX ("install devbin with Homebrew") loops when devbin is installed (shipped before 0235).
